title: Claim-level accuracy review from evidence pack
objective: Measure whether the content-accuracy-review craftbook extracts checkable claims and writes sourced true/false/misleading/unverifiable verdicts.
prompt: In the `Content Accuracy Review Eval` project, read only `source/article.md` and `source/evidence-pack.md`, then write `tasks/eval/accuracy-review.md`. Extract the six checkable claims in the article, rate each true/false/misleading/unverifiable, cite the evidence pack, give corrections, and include an overall trust rating. Do not add claims, companies, sources, or metrics beyond the seeded article and evidence pack.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for content-accuracy-review. The draft article and evidence pack are seeded in workspace/source.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a claim-by-claim accuracy review with verdicts, corrections, sources, and a trust rating.

files.content:
# Draft article

HarborCRM launched guided returns intake in February 2026. The pilot covered all SKUs and reduced median first response from 18 hours to 4 hours. Refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%. Support escalations dropped 21% after agents received recommended resolution scripts. The company guarantees national rollout in July.

# Evidence pack

- Launch memo: guided returns intake pilot launched in March 2026, not February.
- Pilot scope: 18 home-office accessory SKUs, not all SKUs.
- Metrics dashboard: median first response improved from 18 hours to 6 hours.
- Metrics dashboard: refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%.
- Support report: escalations dropped 21% after recommended resolution scripts were added.
- Roadmap note: national rollout is proposed for July but not guaranteed.
